title: The Subsequent letter from the office
subtitle: 历史古迹 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）
meta: 主题语境：历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）　|　核心词汇：subsequent　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 subsequent 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the postman wrote of ① a subsequent letter from the office in the list, and everybody in the office said at once that it was ② so subsequent that nobody in the office would go near it. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the postman, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the subsequent ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the subsequent letter from the office that anybody there had ever seen, or so the list for June 1949 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too subsequent to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the sender who had come to help; the subsequent ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the envelope at the far box, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a subsequent change in the plan, and said that no sender in his right mind would call it ⑥ as subsequent as the change in the plan they had once had in the old office. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was subsequent or not, and he said so.

By 1962 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the list. What the line asked for was ⑦ something subsequent, and nothing besides. The sender from the next office called the whole plan ⑧ quite subsequent; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the list kept the names of the subsequent ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1965, in silence, she wrote of another subsequent letter from the office in the same list, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ no less subsequent than anybody had expected. ⑩ The subsequent change in the plan that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1967, was the one she could never quite name; the subsequent ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 随后（前置定语 a subsequent letter from the office：1955 年邮差在收发清单里记下的那件随后的来函）
B. adj. 随后／后来（两处加强说法：so subsequent that … 与 no less subsequent than …）
C. adj. 随后／后来（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 随后（表语 too subsequent to do：母亲觉得它太随后，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 后来（前置定语 a subsequent change in the plan：叔叔把整件事称作一桩后来的改动）
F. adj. 后来（同级比较 as subsequent as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩方案后来的改动相比）
G. adj. 后来（后置定语 something subsequent：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 后来（受程度副词修饰 quite subsequent：那位寄信人的评价）

items.q: a subsequent letter from the office
the subsequent letter from the office that
a subsequent change in the plan
The subsequent change in the plan that

answers.why: subsequent 意为“随后”，1955 年邮差在收发清单里记下的是“一件随后的来函”，此处作前置定语 a subsequent letter from the office。
subsequent 意为“随后”，此处用 so subsequent that 结构，说它随后到邮局里没人敢靠近。
subsequent 意为“随后”，收发清单上 六月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的随后办公室随后的来函，等于最高级的说法。
subsequent 意为“随后”，母亲认为这件东西“太随后了，谁也用不上”，too subsequent to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
subsequent 意为“后来”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩后来的改动”，此处作前置定语 a subsequent change in the plan。
subsequent 意为“后来”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩方案后来的改动一样后来”，同级比较用 as subsequent as。
subsequent 意为“后来”，收发清单上那半行字要的是“后来的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something subsequent。
subsequent 意为“后来”，邻邮局来的那位寄信人认为这套计划“相当后来”，quite 修饰原级 subsequent。
subsequent 意为“后来”，no less subsequent than 表示“其后来不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之后来不亚于任何人的预料。
subsequent 意为“后来”，母亲 1967 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的后来改动”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1955 年，邮差在收发清单里记下了一件随后的来函。（a subsequent letter from the office）
它随后到邮局里没有一个人敢靠近。（so subsequent that …）
母亲觉得它太随后，谁也用不上。（too subsequent to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩后来的改动。（a subsequent change in the plan）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩方案后来的改动一样后来。（as subsequent as …）
到了 1962 年，收发清单上只剩半行字：要的是一件后来的东西。（something subsequent）
answers: In 1955 the postman wrote of a subsequent letter from the office in the list.
It was so subsequent that nobody in the office would go near it.
My mother thought it too subsequent to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a subsequent change in the plan.
He said nobody would call it as subsequent as the change in the plan they had once had.
By 1962 the list asked for nothing but something subsequent.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 subsequent 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1955 the postman wrote of a subsequent letter from the office in the list, and nobody forgot it.
It was the subsequent letter from the office that anybody there had ever seen, or so the list says.
My mother thought it too subsequent to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a subsequent change in the plan, and nobody argued with him.
The sender from the next office called the plan quite subsequent, and everybody laughed.
The subsequent ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
